subject.title: fix(gateway): defer pre-ready startup maintenance in fast mode

question: Should OpenClaw core accept an opt-in `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_FAST_CONFIG` mode that reports Gateway readiness before channel startup maintenance and startup session migration have settled?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but deciding whether a new core readiness/session-state tradeoff should exist is a product and compatibility choice rather than a mechanical code-review decision.

options.title: Close until sponsored
options.body: Close this PR as unconfirmed product direction and invite a maintainer-sponsored follow-up if the core fast-start mode is wanted.

options.title: Sponsor the opt-in mode
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the readiness/session-state tradeoff and proceed with normal merge validation.

options.title: Ask for a narrower alternative
options.body: Request a diagnostics or profiling-only change that does not add a persistent env mode or change ready-before-migration semantics.

recommendation.title: Close until sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this PR as unconfirmed product direction and invite a maintainer-sponsored follow-up if the core fast-start mode is wanted.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent Gateway startup bootstrap and session migration files route most directly through the area introduced and merged by this owner signal.
